summary.text: Ancient Sword Dragon Transformation is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move that turns him into a silvery ancient sword dragon.

claims.text: Facing Bay Pavilion, Fang Yuan activates rank six change form Immortal Gu, rank seven dragon breath Immortal Gu, rank six dragon scales Immortal Gu, rank seven dragon strength Immortal Gu, and many mortal dragon Gu such as dragon scales Gu, dragon horn Gu, dragon claws Gu, and dragon eyes Gu. Immortal killer move Ancient Sword Dragon Transformation replaces him with an elegant silver sword dragon that emits a sharp, awe-inspiring aura. The sword dragon grabs two Pure Dream Reality Seeker bodies, swings its tail, and uses Immortal Gu Sword Escape to vanish from the spot and appear above Bay Pavilion.

Holding reverse flow protection seal against Wu Yong’s four clear transforming winds takes almost all of Fang Yuan’s attention, so he cannot use ancient sword dragon transformation. Turning only his eyes into dragon eyes stays within his reach.

White light flashes and he turns into a slender silvery sword dragon that waves its tail and moves with rapid speed. He then uses sword escape Immortal Gu on top of ancient sword dragon transformation and flies like a silvery light, tearing through space.

Rank seven perseverance Immortal Gu supplements other Immortal Gu and killer moves in their duration: when Fang Yuan becomes an ancient sword dragon, his sword light dragon breath has to be breathed out each time, but with perseverance Immortal Gu he can use it continuously until his throat reaches its limit.
Against Feng Jiu Ge, ordinary dragon breath could only last a moment, but with perseverance Immortal Gu his sword dragon breath is unceasing and continuous.

Against Feng Jiu Ge in anti-sound desert he deactivates reverse flow protection seal, turns into an ancient sword dragon, then uses myriad self. The pairing is a combination move: ancient sword dragon transformation combined with myriad self creates Myriad Dragon, a sea of silver-scaled sword dragons.

During the anti-sound desert duel with Feng Jiu Ge, narration restates the transformation’s Gu components as rank seven dragon breath Immortal Gu and dragon scale Immortal Gu, with rank six dragon strength Immortal Gu.

He activates myriad self, ancient sword dragon transformation, and reverse flow protection seal. After several breaths he is an ancient sword dragon whose silvery scales shine brightly. Against the immemorial year beast he is tiny until he uses rule path Immortal Gu Big and expands to match its size. Attacks that land on the ancient sword dragon are reflected by reverse flow protection seal, and he later blocks the beast’s escape toward the River of Time with the dragon body.

Against You Chan and Qin Bai He he uses ancient sword dragon transformation with reverse flow protection seal. The sword dragon roars and charges; a flower petal tornado destroys a fake ancient sword dragon, then a huge silver dragon appears behind Qin Bai He with sharp fangs like spears. Reverse flow protection seal reflects You Chan’s attacks, and the ancient sword dragon later bites You Chan when she is unguarded.
